snippet.title: Super Mario Star Scramble Jam  - DEMO Sage 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Remember a Mario flash game where you have to collect stars that are actually Shine?
Well, I'd think it was Super Mario Star Scramble DX.

But that won't be the case today......

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Super Mario Star Scramble Jam is a remastered collection of all four games in the Super Mario Star Scramble series.
Not only does it improve the visuals and run at 60 FPS, but it also adds content and improves the gameplay for the ultimate classic experience.

The Demo currently contains Super Mario Star Scramble 3.
a little extra...
